JOIN A TEAM.

Make a difference.

We believe all people matter and all people have been commissioned by King Jesus to serve His Kingdom purposes.

That's why we empower everyone to play significant roles in everything we do.

Where can I volunteer?

You can volunteer all across our church from the Coffee Team to the Ushers, Crowsnest or Sound, Kids, Youth, and Curriculum Writing. That just scratches the surface, but if you click below, we'll show you every opportunity and help you find the best fit!

How do I start?

Just sign up to serve on this page, and we'll get you started by scheduling a conversation with the Volunteer Coordinator at your campus. This personal conversation will be focused on learning your story and finding your best fit in Crosspoint's culture.

Get in touch to start volunteering!
